fullPassage: Spending time as children allows animals to learn about their environment. Without childhood, animals must rely more fully on hardware, and therefore be less flexible. Among migratory bird species, those that are born knowing how, when, and where to migrate — those that are migrating entirely with instructions they were born with — sometimes have very inefficient migration routes. These birds, born knowing how to migrate, don't adapt easily. So when lakes dry up, forest becomes farmland, or climate change pushes breeding grounds farther north, those birds that are born knowing how to migrate keep flying by the old rules and maps. By comparison, birds with the longest childhoods, and those that migrate with their parents, tend to have the most efficient migration routes. Childhood facilitates the passing on of cultural information, and culture can evolve faster than genes. Childhood gives flexibility in a changing world.

questions.passage: ①So when lakes dry up, forest becomes farmland, or climate change pushes breeding grounds farther north, those birds that are born knowing how to migrate keep flying by the old rules and maps. ②By comparison, birds with the longest childhoods, and those that migrate with their parents, tend to have the least efficient migration routes. ③Childhood facilitates the passing on of cultural information, and culture can evolve faster than genes. ④Childhood gives flexibility in a changing world.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 원문과 다르게 바뀐 부분을 포함하는 것은?

det.korean: ② least efficient(가장 비효율적인) → most efficient(가장 효율적인): 긴 유년기를 가진 새는 '가장 효율적인' 경로를 가짐
det.analysis:
❌ ① So when lakes dry up...: 원문 일치
✅ ② least efficient → most efficient: 원문은 'tend to have the most efficient migration routes(가장 효율적인 경로)'이나 'least efficient(가장 비효율적인)'로 바뀌어 긴 유년기가 유리하다는 논지와 모순 ←정답
❌ ③ Childhood facilitates...: 원문 일치
❌ ④ Childhood gives flexibility...: 원문 일치
det.tip: the most efficient(가장 효율적인) ↔ the least efficient(가장 비효율적인)

questions.passage: Spending time as children allows animals to learn about their environment. Without childhood, animals must rely more fully on hardware, and therefore be less flexible. Among migratory bird species, those that are born knowing how, when, and where to migrate — those that are migrating entirely with instructions they were born with — sometimes have very inefficient migration routes. These birds, born knowing how to migrate, don't adapt easily. So when lakes dry up, forest becomes farmland, or climate change pushes breeding grounds farther north, those birds that are born knowing how to migrate keep flying by the old rules and maps. By comparison, birds with the longest childhoods, and those that migrate with their parents, tend to have the most efficient migration routes. Childhood facilitates the passing on of cultural information, and culture can evolve faster than genes. Childhood gives flexibility in a changing world.
questions.stem: 위 글에서 유년기(Childhood)가 그 전달을 촉진한다고 말한 대상이 무엇인지 본문에서 찾아 영어 2단어로 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 본문 S7 'Childhood facilitates the passing on of cultural information'에서 유년기가 전달(passing on)을 촉진하는 대상은 cultural information(문화적 정보)이다.
det.tip: the passing on of cultural information = 문화적 정보의 전달
